pr_title: fix(router): Allow renavigating to failed URLs
pr_body:
There are situations where the Router does not currently clean up failed navigations
correctly. While this is problematic on its own, we can mitigate some of
the damage by processing any URL when we get a navigation request when
the internal router state is out of sync.

Each of the added tests would fail without this change.

fixes #34795

issue_context.title: Re-navigating to a the same url during an active navigation causes cancellation without a new navigation starting
comments: Bumping frequency to medium as this could be somewhat common for guards to cause re-navigations to the same URL.

Copying this from 34051:

we use the URL to pass parameters to be able to deep link.
So each time you change to another component the URL parameters get updated.
If you have 3 nested components, it means you have 3 URL parameters.

If you then go to another component, where the 3 nested components are destroyed, it should clean up the URL parameters in the ngOnDestroy of the components.

You could of course start to get fancy and create a specific service to do this, and let that service do the clean sequentually with setTimeouts, but that is complicating things unneccesarily and should not be necessary in my opinion.

This causes problems for us as we use router guards to add and remove UI breadcrumbs. When a route is activated, the breadcrumb is added. When a route is deactivated, the breadcrumb is removed. A cancel event is (rightly IMO) interpreted as an aborted deactivation and so the breadcrumb is not removed. The current behaviour of `@angular/router` leaves dangling breadcrumbs which due to the cancel event are not removed even though the navigation completed successfully.
Any updates or workarounds for this issue ?
This is still happening on Angular@10, when re-navigation is triggered from inside of a Guard.
这个问题有解决方案吗？

> 这个问题有解决方案吗？
原因分析：
经过跟踪代码，我发现是因为在组件ngOnDestroy的时候重复调用了一次路由跳转的方法，然而this.router.navigate每执行一次navigationId就会+1，这样就造成了navigationId不匹配，路由事件被取消；
解决办法：
删除组件中ngOnDestroy里重复调用navigate的方法，问题解决之。同理，其它类似的问题也因该是路由的重复调用引起的，建议大家仔细排查代码，删除重复的里有调用即可。

In #42273 @atscott proposed a workaround:
You can navigate inside a `setTimeout` or `Promise.resolve.then(...)`: [https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-ivy-um7fof?file=src%2Fapp%2Fpage.service.ts](https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-ivy-um7fof?file=src%2Fapp%2Fpage.service.ts)
